items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: And then Walter Deku, he was at the country club there at that time. ... I remember when Walter was there.

ctx.x: Who was about the best pianist? Did you, did you have any favorite, any choice of all the fellas you heard when you were young?

Well, the best pianist in that time that I think was, uh, Professor Mineta. Professor Mineta. Yeah, because he was on the boat, you know, at the corner of the boat. And he was the only one playin' that, that organ, you know, at that time. And I used to love to hear that carrier for the car. He used to play that. Then Fat Pichon come in there, you know. Yeah. But he used to be the one that had that job. Mm-hmm. Here with his band. Him and I think it was, uh, Peter Bocard was on there. When you. I think it was at…
Were there any other favorite pianists that were unusually good that you liked?
